description:
**Conversation summary**

1. **Design audit of the Channels view** — fixed unreadable channel surfaces: opacity utilities not generated by the Tailwind config (`bg-white/4·6·8`), meta text at ~2:1 contrast, invisible hover states, and the "seen" progress stripe painted under every message.
2. **`ChatEntry.vue` unified the tools/events trigger** — one button for all panel widths and states, visible while streaming (spinner) and inside channels, where the events panel had been disabled entirely (`!isChannel`).
3. **Removed the double sidebar** — `ChatView` gained a `hideChatSidebar` prop so messenger channels are no longer squeezed between two navigation rails.
4. **`ChatSidebar` moved to the right** via `flex-row-reverse` and extended with an `actions` slot so host views could add their own toolbar buttons.
5. **Members (group info) toggle fixed** — the slot-forwarded button rendered detached at the top-right, so it became a first-class sidebar action (`show-members-action` / `members-active` / `toggle-members`), guaranteed to sit inside the rail's footer with `aria-pressed` and a state-reflecting tooltip.

messages.content:
Channels view design is hard to read, change it.
 ChaTEntry tools are not seen in the channels and make tools icon visible even if message is not done yet.

I found the root causes. Here's my read of the code before changing it: **Findings** - `ChatEntry.vue`: the tools/events trigger is split in two (`v-if="isAssistant && !toolEventCount"` hidden below `@lg/panel`, and a counter version) and the inline panel is gated by `!isChannel` → clicking the wrench in a channel does nothing. So channels show *no* tool activity, and during streaming (0 tools yet, narrow panel) the icon is invisible. - `ChatEntry.vue`: the "seen" bar renders `min-h-2 bg-base-200` **under every message** (opacity only hides the inner progress) → gray stripes in channels. - Channel/messenger surfaces rely on `bg-white/4`, `bg-white/6`, `bg-white/8` and `hover:` (empty) — **not generated by this Tailwind config** (default opacity scale has no 4/6/8) → rows have *no* hover feedback, and most meta text sits at `base-content/20…30` (≈2:1 contrast, far below WCAG AA 4.5:1). - `MessengerView` renders `ChatView`, which renders its *own* `ChatSidebar` → channel content is squeezed between two sidebars. Changes: 5 files. **Summary** | File | Change | |---|---| | `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` | One events/tools trigger: visible for every assistant message, at every panel width, **also while streaming** (spinner) and **in channels**; `` no longer gated by `!isChannel`; channel header/body contrast raised (`base-content/60` meta, `base-content/90` body), row hover surface added; the per-message "seen" stripe is gone in channels and only painted while tracking. | | `src/views/ChatView.vue` | New `hideChatSidebar` prop → no second sidebar when embedded. | | `src/views/MessengerView.vue` | `hide-chat-sidebar` passed to `ChatView` (removes the squeezed message column); all empty states / modal labels / placeholders / bottom nav lifted to readable contrast; `bg-white/4·6·8` (not generated by Tailwind → invisible hover) replaced with `bg-base-content/5·10`; proper `aria`/`label for` on the new-channel form. | | `src/components/messenger/MessengerChannelList.vue` | Channel rows `base-content/70` (was /50), snippets & times /50 (was /30·/25), active row uses `bg-primary/15 + ring` with readable text instead of white-on-tint; visible hover/focus states; `aria-current` + labelled search input. | | `src/components/messenger/MessengerGroupInfo.vue` | Fixed invalid `hover:` classes and low-contrast labels (`/30` → `/50`), member rows readable, remove button always reachable (no hover-only reveal). | **Anti-patterns avoided / worth noting** - Don't hide actions behind hover on touch devices (fixed in group info). - Don't use non-scale opacity utilities (`/4`, `/6`, `/8`) with this Tailwind config — they generate nothing. - State is never color-only: the tools trigger shows spinner/neutral wrench + tooltip, channel rows use ring + `aria-current`.

messages.content: Move chatsidebar to right "flex-row-reverse". Add custom actions slot to chatsidebar so we can add the "group info" icon in messenger channels

I read the current files. Two structural points drove the change: - `ChatView.vue` renders `ChatSidebar` **before** the content column, so reversing the flex flow is a one-class change; the mobile drawer is `fixed` and unaffected. - `MessengerView.vue` currently passes `hide-chat-sidebar="true"`, so a slot forwarded into `ChatSidebar` would never render there. The channel members toggle must move into that (now right-hand) rail, which means messenger stops hiding the chat sidebar and drops its absolutely positioned button that overlapped the chat header. Changes: 3 files. **Summary** | File | Change | |---|---| | `src/components/chat/ChatSidebar.vue` | New **`actions`** slot in the footer toolbar (between the ⋯ dropdown and the collapse toggle), so host views inject buttons that inherit the toolbar layout (row when expanded, column when compact). Comment documents the exact button classes to reuse. | | `src/views/ChatView.vue` | Root flex is now **`flex-row-reverse`** → `ChatSidebar` sits on the **right**; new **`sidebar-actions`** slot forwarded into `ChatSidebar`'s `actions` slot (desktop only; the mobile drawer is a `fixed` overlay and keeps its current behaviour). | | `src/views/MessengerView.vue` | The members (group info) toggle moved out of the floating `absolute top-3 right-3` button — which overlapped the chat header controls — into the chat sidebar rail via `#sidebar-actions`; `hide-chat-sidebar` removed so that rail exists (channel list left · conversation · chat rail right, Discord-style). Active state uses `text-primary bg-primary/15` + `aria-pressed`; mobile keeps the bottom-nav Members button. | **Notes / trade-offs** - The rail defaults to `compactSidebar: true`, so in messenger it renders as a 64px icon rail (root chat avatar, member avatars, browser session, ⋯ menu, members, collapse) instead of a wide subtasks panel. - `hideChatSidebar` stays supported for hosts that genuinely need no sidebar — they simply pass no `#sidebar-actions` and the slot renders nothing. - Members panel opens to the right of the rail (`channels | conversation | rail | members`); if you prefer it inside the rail order, the aside can be moved inside `ChatView`, but that would couple messenger state into the shared view.

Making it a **first-class sidebar action** removes the indirection entirely. **Summary** | File | Change | |---|---| | `src/components/chat/ChatSidebar.vue` | Members toggle is now a **built-in footer-toolbar action** (`show-members-action` / `members-active` / `members-count` + `toggle-members` emit). It's painted by the sidebar itself, aligned with the sibling buttons (row when expanded, column when compact), with `aria-pressed` + tooltip that carries the member count. Root gained `min-h-0` so the rail stays a real full-height column and the footer can never be pushed out of the sidebar. The host `actions` slot stays for *extra* buttons. | | `src/views/ChatView.vue` | Forwards `sidebarMembers*` props + `@toggle-members` to **both** ChatSidebar instances (desktop rail and mobile drawer). The `sidebar-actions` slot is still forwarded for extra host buttons. | | `src/views/MessengerView.vue` | No more slot indirection: `ChatView` receives `:sidebar-members="true"`, `:sidebar-members-active="showGroupInfo"`, `:sidebar-members-count` and `@toggle-members`. The icon is therefore rendered **inside the chat sidebar rail** (right rail, footer toolbar) instead of anywhere else in the layout; mobile keeps the bottom-nav Members button (`aria-pressed` added). | **Why this fixes it** - Before, the button was markup passed down two slot hops (`#sidebar-actions` → `#actions`) and then had to be laid out by the sidebar's footer flex row. Any break in that chain (or a footer pushed out of the rail) leaves the control rendering outside the sidebar. - Now the sidebar owns the button: same component, same footer, same classes as the browser-session / ⋯ / collapse buttons, so it cannot drift to the top-right corner or float over the chat header. - No new state: `showGroupInfo` is still owned by `MessengerView`; only the *rendering location* moved. **Accessibility** - `aria-pressed` on the toggle (color is never the only signal), tooltip/label announces state and member count, `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50` on focus, `h-9` (36px) target in a 64px rail — the surrounding buttons share the same size, and mobile gets a 44px+ bottom-nav target.
